description:
Your Mind Believes What You Repeatedly Tell It

Today’s Episode of @saturnreturnsco I am joined by @marisapeertherapy 

Our brains are constantly looking for evidence to support the stories we tell ourselves. Every thought becomes a blueprint, influencing how we feel, behave and ultimately experience life. 

Rather than working against your mind, Marisa explains that we should learn how it works so it can work for us. For example, switching “this is hard” for “this is unfamiliar” 

To listen to this episode of Saturn Returns comment ‘Marisa’ and I will send you the link.

This episode was made possible by our friends at @theofficialpandora to celebrate the launch of their new Pandora talisman collection ✨
